institution_or_author: Allen Institute for AI & Google Research
description: Massive cleaned web crawl corpus of natural Bengali text from Common Crawl, suitable for pre-training large language models (BERT, RoBERTa, GPT). Due to immense size (>30 GB compressed, >100 GB uncompressed), streaming loaders are provided to conserve local storage.
python_load_code:
from datasets import load_dataset
ds = load_dataset('allenai/c4', 'bn', split='train', streaming=True)

python_load_code:
from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModel
tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('csebuetnlp/banglabert')
